submission.justification: Sensor-T2 at 150 μm thickness is recommended because it achieves the best single-hit spatial resolution of 9 μm among all viable options. Sensor-T1 must be excluded as it fails to meet the hard requirement of 97% hit efficiency at end-of-life fluence (achieving only 82%). While Sensor-T3 meets the efficiency requirement with 99.2%, its spatial resolution of approximately 14 μm is significantly worse than Sensor-T2's 9 μm. Sensor-T2 provides the optimal balance, delivering superior spatial resolution (9 μm) while comfortably exceeding the 97% efficiency requirement with 98.5% at 2e16 neq/cm². The 150 μm thickness falls within the allowed 50-300 μm range and represents the optimal thickness for Sensor-T2 based on the simulation results.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible single-hit spatial resolution in the innermost layer
requirements.evidence: Sensor-T2 at 150 μm achieves 9 μm spatial resolution, which is the best among all valid options (T2 at various thicknesses: 9-11.974 μm; T3 at various thicknesses: 14.289-18.834 μm; T1 is invalid)
